name: POSH Complaint
description: A formal complaint received by the POSH Internal Committee. HIGHLY CONFIDENTIAL. Uses Frappe permlevel: party identity, action, and evidence fields are permlevel=1 — visible only to POSH IC Members and System Manager. Even Compliance Officers cannot read these. Audit logs must redact permlevel-1 fields. Inquiry must complete within 90 days of receipt.

fields.label: Receiving IC
fields.description: The Internal Committee receiving and handling this complaint.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Received
Under Inquiry
Conciliation
Report Submitted
Disposed - Substantiated
Disposed - Not Substantiated
Withdrawn
Referred to Police

fields.label: Mode of Complaint
fields.options:
Written
Email
Verbal-Recorded
Third Party
Self-by-IC

fields.label: Filed Within 3 Months
fields.description: Statutory limitation period: 3 months from date of incident. Extendable up to 3 additional months if IC satisfied cause is shown.

fields.label: Limitation Extension Granted
fields.description: IC may extend up to 3 months beyond the initial 3-month window if cause is shown.

fields.label: Parties (Confidential)
fields.description: CONFIDENTIAL — permlevel 1. Only POSH IC Members and System Manager can read or write these fields. Compliance Officer, Internal Auditor, and all other roles are EXCLUDED. Audit logs redact these fields.

fields.label: Complainant ID
fields.description: Internal anonymised ID only — NEVER use real name in code, logs, or notifications. E.g. ANON-001.

fields.label: Complainant User
fields.description: If internal employee. Never displayed in subject lines or shared notifications.

fields.label: Complainant Relationship
fields.options:
Direct Employee
Contract Worker
Intern
Visitor
Client/Vendor
Other

fields.label: Respondent ID
fields.description: Internal anonymised ID only. Never expose in notifications or shared reports.

fields.label: Respondent Senior to Complainant
fields.description: Power imbalance factor — relevant to interim relief assessment.

fields.label: Inquiry Target Completion
fields.description: Statutory deadline: inquiry must complete within 90 days of complaint receipt (POSH Act §11). Alert fires at 75 days.

fields.label: Report Submitted On
fields.description: IC report must be submitted within 10 days of inquiry completion (POSH Act §13).

fields.label: Interim Relief Granted
fields.description: E.g. transfer complainant (with consent), grant leave, impose no-contact order (POSH Act §12).

fields.label: Outcome
fields.options:
Substantiated
Not Substantiated
False Allegation
No Verdict (Withdrawn)
Referred to Police

fields.label: Action Recommended
fields.description: IC's recommended action to the employer. Confidential — permlevel 1.

fields.label: Action Taken by Employer
fields.description: Employer must act on recommendation within 60 days. Confidential — permlevel 1.

fields.label: Case File Evidence (Restricted)
fields.description: CONFIDENTIAL — permlevel 1. Case documents, statements, evidence. Accessible only to POSH IC Members.

fields.label: Case File Evidence
fields.description: Each piece of documentary evidence for this case. Never exposed in external reports.

permissions.description: System Manager gets permlevel-0 access only by default. permlevel-1 requires explicit role grant.
IC Members access confidential fields (parties, evidence, action).
Compliance Officer sees meta (status, dates, IC) but NOT parties, evidence, or action details.
